name: Wispr Flow
summary: Wispr Flow is a voice-first keyboard app that replaces the iOS system keyboard with an AI-powered dictation interface. Users speak and Flow transcribes, reformats, and adapts the output to different tones (formal, casual, very casual, excited). It functions across all apps via the custom keyboard mechanism. The app offers a free Basic tier (1,000 words/week on iOS, 2,000/week on desktop) and a paid Pro tier (unlimited words, all devices, command mode). The session covered onboarding through full app exploration while attempting to exhaust the free word limit to unlock a stats feature.
